title: SLASH · The green coat
venue: Box 4B · sixty pages · never lettered for print
logline: Page one of the phantom novel: a woman in a green coat at the frame shop's counter at closing with a photograph she wants matted and won't let the framer see. Rain in the alley in vertical hatching. The framer isn't Wood; he has Wood's hands.

panels.composition: Full page, three stacked panels without gutters: the frame shop at closing in rain; a woman in a green coat sliding a photograph face-down across the counter; the framer's hands — ink-stained — not turning it over.

balloons.text: Mat it. Don't look at it.

image.prompt: black and white noir comic page, brush-pen over blue pencil, rain as dense vertical hatching, stark black spotting, a frame shop at closing with rain hatched in the window, a woman in a dark coat sliding a photograph face-down across a counter to a man whose ink-stained hands rest on it
image.notes: The green coat: the color the canon gives the Lisbon coat and the dock's coat (2024). Here it's 2001 and it's hers.

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; rain in frantic vertical hatching; stark spotting; Arc 1's aesthetic pushed to noir
art.palette: black and white; one gray wash for the wet
